news.headline: U.S. sanctions Hezbollah, links group to Iran's IRGC‑Quds Force
news.body: The U.S. Treasury re‑designated Lebanon’s Hezbollah and announced fresh sanctions, saying the group acted on behalf of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps‑Quds Force. The measures target financing networks and couriers and aim to disrupt the group's international funding and logistics.
